environment.description: Same Django REST application deployed on a GKE Autopilot cluster (v1.28) where the namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted applied. The cluster's built-in admission controller enforces Pod Security Standards at the 'restricted' profile level. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' with validationFailureAction: Enforce is active, and the GKE Workload Identity federation is configured so the KSA maps to a GCP SA with only roles/storage.objectViewer on the documents bucket. The container image is built with a distroless base running as UID 65534 (nobody). Note: the PSS restricted profile validation occurs at pod scheduling time and rejects any spec containing hostPath volumes, privileged securityContext, or runAsUser: 0.
